### New
- **Integration icon**: the integration now ships its own icon (`brand/icon.png`, `icon@2x.png`), shown on the integrations page and in HACS with Home Assistant 2026.9+. It shows a cross-flow heat exchanger with warm and cool air and is not the Maico logo.

### Changes
- Release workflow publishes releases with notes from `.github/release-notes/`.

No changes to entities or configuration; updating from 0.2.0 needs no action. See the [0.2.0 notes](https://github.com/rolflied/maico-kwl/releases/tag/v0.2.0) when updating from 0.1.x.
